scope: Eight public metadata records: six from the main 118-evaluation suite and two supplemental neoantigen examples outside that suite. These are eight inspected records, not eight of 118 benchmark tasks.

tasks.assessment: Public task description assessed for workflow requirements; source inputs, task text, answers and trajectories are excluded from training authoring. Input files were not retrieved.
required_stages: harmonize exposure and outcome summary alleles
select usable independent cis instruments
account for linkage disequilibrium
fit locus-specific causal estimates
assess instrument strength and horizontal pleiotropy
scientific_decisions: Do not substitute genetic correlation or nearby-gene association for a causal intervention estimate; preserve uncertainty and non-identifiability when instruments are absent.
remaining_gaps: Do not substitute genetic correlation or nearby-gene association for a causal intervention estimate; preserve uncertainty and non-identifiability when instruments are absent.
Implement and validate the connected workflow using independent real observations, pinned methods and complete artifact checks.
